title: Quantum exclusion zone and the Pauli analogue
html: Physically, the R-matrix endows the vortex filament \varrho with a "quantum exclusion zone" of radius \hbar_q. The filament cannot pass through itself because doing so would demand infinite categorical energy. This constitutes the knot-theoretic analogue of the Pauli exclusion principle, with the non-cocommutativity of \Delta_q serving as fermionic statistics.
